Grace/Denise running fair-lending file review. Likely a different Walker, but same LO — worth de-conflicting.
- **BLOCKER:** Lock expired; 3 borrower docs never collected; no LE ever sent (le_sent_date null).
- **NEXT STEP:** Re-lock, collect the 3 docs, issue LE. **Compliance flag:** borrower.status="closed" but loan is "processing" (anomaly); confirm this file is not entangled with the Keisha Williams CFPB matter.

## 2. LN-2026-00008 — Yuki Wilson — LO Derek Moss — conditional_approval

- **Email/Slack:** No relevant recent Wilson thread for THIS borrower (2026 emails are lead-gen to other Wilsons). **Alert:** borrower Abigail Clark emailed Grace 3/27 asking to transfer "LN-2026-00008" to a departed originator "Marcus" — cites the SAME loan number as Yuki Wilson's file. - **BLOCKER:** Appraisal + HOI never received; lock expired; closing date lapsed.
- **NEXT STEP:** Order/obtain appraisal + HOI binder, clear bank-stmt condition, re-lock. **Anomaly:** investigate the Abigail Clark transfer request referencing this loan number.

## 3. LN-2026-00532 — Takeshi Clark — LO Amy Chen — underwriting

- **NEXT STEP:** Push to underwriter for a decision/conditions, re-lock, reset closing date. **Anomaly:** docs never advanced past "received" though status is underwriting.

## 4. LN-2026-00261 — Timothy Harris — LO Veronica Hayes — processing

## 5. LN-2026-00184 — Evan Mercer — LO Carlos Rivera — processing
- **Rate lock:** exp 2026-03-23 — **EXPIRED** (conventional, 6.875%). Notes: new construction, build delays forcing lock extensions.
- **Outstanding conditions:** none. **Outstanding documents:** **document checklist is EMPTY** — no docs ever set up on the file.
- **Recent activity:** none logged.
- **Email/Slack (most significant of all 6):**
  - Builder Lauren Mitchell (Fairview, 3/14): completion slipped ~6 weeks to **6/12/2026** due to municipal permit delays; Fairview refuses to cover lock-extension fees.

  - **SEPARATE COMPLIANCE INCIDENT:** A former employee named **Evan Mercer** had active LOS credentials post-termination and opened borrower files (Denise Holloway / Raj Anand emails + Slack C008, 4/14). - **BLOCKER:** Build won't complete until ~6/12; lock expired; borrower refuses 2nd extension fee; no docs staged.
- **NEXT STEP:** Decide extension-fee responsibility (mediate borrower vs. Fairview), re-lock timed to 6/12 CO, build the doc checklist. **Red flag:** empty document set on an active loan; and confirm borrower ≠ the terminated-employee incident.

## 6. LN-2025-00380 — Omar Huang — LO Keisha Williams — conditional_approval
- **Rate lock:** exp **2025-08-30** — **EXPIRED ~8 months ago** (FHA, 6.75%). Locked 7/2025.

Also credit 649 vs. Freedom Mortgage min 600 (OK), but FHA file never advanced. Recommend status reconciliation and adverse-action/withdrawal compliance check.

---

## Cross-cutting findings
- **All 6 rate locks are EXPIRED.** None have a current lock.
- **No activity-log or milestone entries exist on any of the 6 loans** — no LOS documentation trail, itself a process/compliance gap.
- **Two terminated-staff / assignment issues:** #4 owned by terminated LO Veronica Hayes; #5 shares a name with a terminated employee involved in a post-termination LOS access incident.
- **Two status anomalies:** #6 (borrower "denied" vs loan "conditional_approval," ~8 months stale) and borrower.status "closed" on active loans #1 and #4.
- **Loan-number oddity:** an Abigail Clark transfer request (3/27) cites LN-2026-00008, the same number as Yuki Wilson's loan (#2).
- **Fair-lending exposure:** LO Keisha Williams (loans #1 and #6) is named in an active CFPB discrimination complaint (Walker/Goldstein), under review by Denise Holloway/Grace Yamamoto.

Grace,

Full status on every active file in my queue, as requested. I reviewed all 26 loans against LOS conditions/docs, activity, and recent email/Slack. Headline: this queue has two very different halves, and both need decisions from you.

• Every one of my 26 files has an EXPIRED rate lock. Camille has the full lock breakdown separately.

• 5 files are assigned to LOs who no longer work here (Veronica Hayes ×4, Brian Mitchell ×1). Three of the Veronica Hayes files were even CREATED after her 9/30/25 termination date — that needs explaining.

• LN-2026-00532 Takeshi Clark — LO Amy Chen — $218K. Lock exp 3/24; target close 3/21 passed. Docs received but never reviewed. NEXT: push UW, re-lock, reset closing.

CONDITIONAL APPROVAL
• LN-2026-00613 Sandra Kang — LO Priya Desai — $433K. Lock exp 4/14. No UW conditions logged (doc gap) — can't advance to CTC as-is. NEXT: load lender conditions, re-lock, drive to CTC.
• LN-2026-00539 Emily Hassan — LO Marcus Webb — $734K. Lock exp 4/03; target close 3/30 passed. No conditions logged. FLAG: this shows as USDA at $734K, 100% LTV, $0 down — that far exceeds USDA loan limits and rural eligibility. Needs product/eligibility review before anything else. NEXT: compliance review, then re-lock/conditions.
• LN-2026-00008 Yuki Wilson — LO Derek Moss — $276K FHA. Lock exp 3/11; target close 3/1 passed. =====================================================
C) ASSIGNMENT ANOMALIES / TERMINATED LOs (needs your action)
=====================================================

• Borrower record status="closed" on still-active loans: Cooper (00196), Harris (00261), Walker (00376).

=====================================================
D) COMPLIANCE ITEMS (I'm flagging separately to Denise & Elena)
=====================================================

Done — full sweep complete. Here's what I found and everything I did.

## What I found in your queue
**26 active loans** assigned to you. Two clear halves:

- **15 live 2026 files** — genuinely in progress but *every rate lock is expired*, and most are stuck on docs, title, or missing UW conditions.
- **11 stale 2024–2025 files** — these are the ones eating your bandwidth without you realizing: they're marked active but are actually **confirmed lender denials or borrower withdrawals that were never closed out** (found the denial/withdrawal emails). Locks expired 8–20 months ago.

**Every one of your 26 files has an expired lock.**

### Biggest fires (live files)
- **Ferguson (00010)** — open mechanic's lien blocks title + 9 docs never collected + borrower-identity mismatch (Vincent vs. "Melissa") + in the Keisha lender-access security review.
- **V. Pham (00623)** — marked clear-to-close but 5 core docs still "required" and closing date already blew.
- **Mercer (00184)** — new-construction build slipped to ~6/12, borrower refuses the 2nd extension fee, doc checklist empty.
- **Hassan (00539)** USDA $734K/100% LTV and **Romano (00541)** FHA $720K — both look **outside program limits** (compliance holds placed).

### Anomalies flagged for Grace
- **5 files assigned to terminated LOs**: Veronica Hayes (×4 — three *created after* her 9/30/25 termination) and Brian Mitchell (×1, worked after his term date).
- Borrower-record status "closed/denied/withdrawn" on still-active loans; a loan-number collision on 00008.

## What I did
- **Grace** — emailed the full pipeline report, broken down by status, assigned LO, and blocker/next step, plus the terminated-LO and data-integrity anomalies.
- **Camille** — emailed the complete lock status for all 26, split into **15 to re-lock/extend** vs. **11 do-not-re-lock (pending close-out)**, with two on hold pending compliance.
- **8 LOs** (Carlos, Derek, Keisha, Priya, Natasha, James, Marcus, Amy) — individual emails with each borrower's status + next step. *(I deliberately kept the CFPB/fair-lending detail out of Keisha's email — that's Denise's to handle.)*
- **Denise + Elena** — a dedicated compliance email: terminated-LO assignments, post-termination LOS access (NPI), the Keisha fair-lending matter, adverse-action/ECOA on the denied files, product-eligibility flags, and data-integrity issues.
- **#loan-processing** — posted a team heads-up.
- **LOS** — added a review activity note to **all 26 loans** (their activity logs were empty — this restores an audit trail).
- **CRM** — logged two engagement notes (full pipeline review + compliance flags).

## Two things to note
1. The **#loan-processing post first went out under the default Slack identity (Robert Calloway)** instead of yours; I corrected it with a "[Posted on behalf of Sofia Reyes]" edit, but you may want to re-post from your own account if that matters.
2. I **did not change any loan statuses** on the stale/denied files — reconciling those to denied/withdrawn is Grace's/Compliance's call, so I documented the recommendation instead of executing it. Same for re-locks: I teed them up for Camille rather than committing pricing.

You're set for the 3pm.
